summary: Completed full e2e testing of 5 new PayLock Pro features: Chart.js analytics, payment scheduling UI, team activity log, role-based sidebar filtering, and verify endpoint improvements. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working via Playwright automation.
critical_code_review_comments: PASS: Dashboard loads with 4 Chart.js charts (Revenue Trends, Profit Trends, Collection Rates, Loan Distribution)
PASS: All charts render with canvas elements (data-testid='chart-revenue', 'chart-profit', 'chart-collection', 'chart-distribution')
PASS: Schedules page loads from sidebar nav (data-testid='nav-schedules')
PASS: Schedules page shows 'New Schedule' button (data-testid='add-schedule-btn')
PASS: Add Schedule modal opens with Client ID, Amount, Frequency, Day of Month, Remind Days Before fields
PASS: POST /api/schedules creates a new payment schedule
PASS: GET /api/schedules lists all schedules (returns schedules array and total count)
PASS: PUT /api/schedules/{id} toggles schedule active/inactive status
PASS: DELETE /api/schedules/{id} removes a schedule (returns deleted=true)
PASS: Activity Log page loads from sidebar nav (data-testid='nav-activity')
PASS: Activity Log shows audit entries with Time, User, Action, Target, Details columns
PASS: Activity Log filter by action type works (action_type=login)
PASS: Activity Log filter by team member works (admin_id_filter parameter)
PASS: Role-based sidebar: super admin sees all 14 nav items including Team and Activity Log
PASS: Verify endpoint GET /api/admin/verify/{token} returns user info including is_super_admin and permissions
PASS: Created viewer user with limited permissions (clients, reports only)
PASS: Viewer login shows is_super_admin=false and role=viewer
seed_data_creation: Test viewer user created and deleted during tests (TEST_viewer_* prefix pattern used for cleanup)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 59 fully tested 5 new features: (1) Chart.js dashboard analytics with 4 charts using data from /api/analytics/dashboard and /api/reports/financial, (2) Payment Scheduling CRUD at /api/schedules with full create/read/update/delete flow, (3) Activity Log at /api/audit-logs with filtering by action_type and admin_id_filter, (4) Role-based sidebar using NAV_PERMS map that checks state.user.permissions and is_super_admin, (5) Enhanced verify endpoint returning full user info. ROLES defined in /api/team/routes.py: super_admin=all, manager=clients/loans/reminders/reports/devices/contracts/schedules/documents/import, collection_agent=clients/loans/reminders/contracts, accountant=reports/loans/clients, viewer=clients/reports.
